title: The world changes: ideas, revolutions and the crisis of 1808
goal: I can explain what changed in the world before 1808 and why the crisis in Spain mattered in America.
grammar: Pluperfect: what had already happened by 1808

items: I can say what had already happened in the world when Napoleon invaded Spain.
I can describe how new ideas reached America.
I can explain why the crisis of 1808 started the juntas.
I can say what the Cadiz constitution of 1812 was.
I can use había + past participle to say what had already happened before a past moment.
